evidence.source: Contracts 206 through 208 were applied to Production on 20 August 2026 by guarded rollout run 32318082186 from exact main f2c244b6a4a0fb27e81624df41a9e893d39bd565, coordinated by run 32317678763 and gated on fresh encrypted backup run 32312404053 plus exact-head disposable-restore rehearsal run 32317690357. The rehearsal PASSED before Production mutation: the live Production database was dumped and restored to a disposable Supabase copy, exactly the three additive migrations 20260819110000_same_season_player_profile.sql, 20260819120000_cup_phase_determinate_membership.sql and 20260819130000_cup_bracket_outcome_and_knockout_stage.sql were applied, behavioural pgTAP suites passed, and Production-derived protected state was unchanged. Protected Production state matches the pre-rollout baseline exactly: 1 auth user, 1 profile, 3 entries, 16 season predictions, 36 match predictions, 0 season matchweek scores, 4 competition entrants, 1 league, 1 league member, 0 Cup launches, 0 Cup fixtures, 578 season fixtures, 230 ai bets, 397 ai.api_usage rows, 11 cron jobs, and both publication gates false. After this direct database proof, EURO28_DEPLOYED_DB_CONTRACT was raised from 205 to 208 in the Production build context of both active Netlify projects; direct Netlify read-back confirmed dev, branch-deploy, deploy-preview and production all declare 208 on both predictorhub and euro28predictor. The Netlify variable change is configuration evidence, not proof of a newly published bundle.
